referenceFidelity.findings: Compared final actual GLB with selected06 and approved two-page spec: fitted pale teal/chalk panel cap, narrow centre seam, short curved brim and single chalk pencil with teal holder/wood point on wearer-left. Open navy face with only two cyan capsule eyes; no goggles, pointed brows, diamond, charts or mouth. Broad lower head contour and segmented ear housings retained. Upper hidden dome intentionally cut to receive cap.

construction.findings: Actual front/profile, close oblique, rear and underside checked. Geometric cut closes the old dome on a coherent seating plane, removing its protrusion and crimped contour. Cap panel colours share a surface; continuous lower band seats against shell. Brim has top/underside and closed edges. Pencil shaft/point and holder are closed, holder enters cap side. No exposed old optic parts or crossing crown plates remain. Rear band edge remains intentionally faceted, without the earlier compressed-dome folds.

readability.findings: Final phone and small views inspected: cap/brim and side pencil recognizable; eyes remain visible below brim at intended isometric angle. Broad head/ear silhouette retained. Chalk/pale teal panel distinction and dark face contrast read without viewer tint. Pencil increased to remain a visible secondary tool at phone scale.

motion.findings: Model implementation only. Baseline animations not authorized; no rig or placeholder clips.

secondPass.findings: First candidate exceeded2500 triangles and was rejected without replacing runtime; reduced cap sampling. Initial promoted r8 exposed old forehead intersecting cap. Compression in r9 left a crimped rear join; r10 added a band and adjusted pencil; r11 replaced compression with a closed geometric cut. Final r12 restores denser cap/brim sampling within budget. Personally rechecked the finished r12 oblique, reverse, underside and phone views against selected06/spec after those repairs. Shape/clearance and broad source lower volume remain coherent; actual2390 triangles with current Inspector hash matching delivery.

userAcceptance.note: User accepted Session Cap spec pages and authorized implementation. Artistic acceptance of resulting revision12 remains pending.
